prompt.en: What can we learn from early Indian society about varṇa and the role of women? Answer in about 100 words.

label.en: Varṇa divided society by function, and its flexibility reduced over time

level1.en: What was varṇa based on at first, and did it stay the same?

clue.en: Varṇa was a division of social roles: brāhmaṇa, kṣhatriya, vaiśhya and śhūdra. It was described as a functional division, and its flexibility reduced over time.

level2Template.en: Varṇa was a division based on ___, and it became less flexible over time.

label.en: Women took part in learning, ritual, work and public life, and some are named in the records

level1.en: Name one thing the sources show women doing.

clue.en: Women took part in scholarly learning and attended the sabhā. Hymns are attributed to women sages, Sangam women farmed and spun, and Prabhāvatī Gupta issued land grants as a regent.

level2Template.en: The sources show women taking part in ___, among other things.

label.en: The position of women changed over time and sometimes declined

level1.en: Did the position of women stay the same in every period?

clue.en: The position and roles of women fluctuated, even declined, as social and political conditions changed. Women still contributed to household management, agriculture, crafts and religious practices.

level2Template.en: Over time, the position and roles of women ___ as conditions changed.
